name: qa-unit-tests-go-rust
description: Go + Rust unit testing: 2 umbrella skills - go-unit-tests (stdlib testing: table-driven t.Run subtests, benchmarks, native fuzzing, coverage, -race CI; Ginkgo + Go mocking as references) and rust-unit-tests (cargo test: #[test], integration + doc tests, coverage, Criterion; rstest + mockall as references) - each with framework choice and test-authoring conventions.
